name: The Chess Club
description: Regulars at the chess club each swear by a different opening, a favourite tactic, and a prized set. Work out who plays what.
clues: Anatoly, Benoni, and Discovery belong to different players.
Sacrifice goes with exactly one of Anatoly, Italian, or Slav.
Exactly two of Anatoly, the player who loves the Discovery, the player who loves the Fork, and the player who loves the Skewer belong to the King's-Pawn Camp.
Either Garry goes with Benoni, or Nadia goes with Slav — but not both.
Between Garry and Skewer, one goes with Benoni and the other with Slav.
